# Tank Editor - Configuration

[&lt;&lt; Back](../Tank%20Editor.md) \| <a href="#" class="selected">Main</a> \| [Characteristics](Tank%20Editor_Config%20-%20Characteristics%20Tab.md) \| [Units & Options](Tank%20Editor_Config%20-%20Units-Options%20Tab.md) \| [Site](Tank%20Editor_Config%20-%20Site%20Tab.md) \| [BLM](Tank%20Editor_Config%20-%20BLM%20Tab.md)

#### Main Tab

The following options are available on the Main tab:

- **Tank Type** - Options for this field are Production Tank (upright cylindrical), Product Tank (upright cylindrical), Horizontal Tank, or Spherical Tank.
- **Roof Type** - If the tank type is specified as either "Production Tank" or "Product Tank", a Roof Type field will become available. Options for this field are "Fixed Roof", "Floating Roof", or "No Roof".
- **Construction Material** - The construction material is used when calculating the liquid and vapor temperature corrections of the tank.
- **Tank is Insulated** - If the tank is insulated, the tank shell temperature correction (CTSh) will be calculated using only the liquid temperature. If the tank is not insulated, the CTSh will be calculated using the liquid temperature and the ambient temperature as per API.
- **Nominal Tank Capacity** - This is the maximum capacity of the tank. For reference only; it is not used in any calculation
- **Reference Meter** - A reference meter is required upon creation of a new tank. The contract day and hour from the reference meter will be used to calculate the rollup IDs for the tank tickets.
- **Injection Point** - A previously defined station location in FLOWCAL that will act as the inlet to the tank. Optional.
- **Withdrawal Point** - A previously defined station location in FLOWCAL that will act as the outlet to the tank. Optional.
